title: NEXT-IMDL: BUILD BENCHMARK FOR NEXT-GENERATION IMAGE MANIPULATION DETECTION & LOCALIZATION

bias_targets.methodology: Cross-Semantic-Labels (Cross-SL) protocol: Training detection models on images with specific manipulated object categories (e.g., Human, Animal, Object) and testing them on unseen semantic categories to measure performance degradation and the model's reliance on semantic priors (shortcut learning) rather than actual manipulation artifacts.

Cross-Edit-Granularity (Cross-EG) protocol: Training and testing models on disjoint sets of forgery sizes (e.g., small, medium, large edited areas) to evaluate their multi-scale analysis capabilities and measure their brittleness/bias toward specific manipulation scales present in their training data.
